business and administration.why:
Whether you’re returning to work, preparing for the workplace, or upskilling in your current role, studying Business and Administration will help you to gain essential knowledge in carrying out a range of administrative tasks.

It’s important to set goals in your studies, as goal-setting gives you control over your learning.

Research has proven that people who write their goals down have a greater motivation to achieve them.

will: Know the employment rights and responsibilities of the employee and employer
can: Identify the main points of contracts of employment
Identify the main points of legislation affecting employers and employees
Identify where to find information on employment rights and responsibilities both internally and externally
Describe how representative bodies can support the employees
Identify employer and employee responsibilities for equality and diversity in a business environment
Explain the benefits of making sure equality and diversity procedures are followed in a business environment
